benefitRows.name: AdaniOne
benefitRows.description: 15% savings on duty-free with AdaniOne (once per month; min order Rs 3,000; max order Rs 7,500).
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the AdaniOne Shopping website or app using your registered account. Shop duty-free products with a minimum order of ₹3,000. Apply your HSBC Taj credit card during checkout to get a 15% discount (valid once per month; maximum order value ₹7,500). For support, contact HSBC customer care at 1800 103 4724.
